message: 柔らかいのは胸だけじゃない

name: Ria
message: 「Hmm-hmm...?」

name: Helena
message: 「Come in」

name: Synn
message: 「Excuse me」

name: Helena
message: 「Hii, Synn-chan\s04」

name: Ria
message: 「Hrmm? U-Umm...?」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, Ria-senpai is here. Should I come back later?」

name: Helena
message: 「My, you're more than welcome. Go ahead and tell me what you need」

name: Synn
message: 「Right, umm...」

name: Ria
message: 「U-Uhhn? Mmm? Hrmm...」
What's got into Ria-senpai?

name: Helena
message: 「You don't need to worry about Ria, okay?」

name: Synn
message: 「R-Right」

name: Synn
message: 「Ahem, ahem... *cough*! As Student Council President, I have come to report on Kirafes!」

name: Helena
message: 「Oh my, how valiant」

name: Synn
message: 「With the main event tomorrow, preparations are nearly complete」

name: Synn
message: 「It may not be the absolute best, but I believe we gave our all to everything we could do as the Student Council」

name: Helena
message: 「Geez, you're just as stiff as Ria. Big sis is gonna get mad at you!」

name: Synn
message: 「Helena-san?」

name: Helena
message: 「Ufufu. Synn-chan, what is Ryuusei Academy known for?」

name: Synn
message: 「It's a two-story building」

name: Helena
message: 「Its school culture that values student freedom and responsibility」

name: Synn
message: 「I-I'm sorry! You meant that kind of question」

name: Helena
message: 「You're the boy leading all of those students, Synn-chan... You came to report a day too early」

name: Synn
message: 「B-But there's no more Student Council work to do until tomorrow, you know?」

name: Helena
message: 「And that's fine. At this stage, the Student Council President doesn't need to handle any concrete duties」

name: Helena
message: 「Still, you shouldn't be coming to places like the chairwoman's office. Take your time and walk around the campus」

name: Synn
message: 「An inspection?」

name: Helena
message: 「That's what it amounts to in the end. Don't be so stiff about it, though, Synn-chan」

name: Helena
message: 「Just relax and interact with everyone as a friend, an underclassman, or an upperclassman」

name: Helena
message: 「Even without giving orders, just having the commander present on the scene creates a good sense of tension and reassurance」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah...! So the reason you're always popping up all over the academy, Helena-san, is――」

name: Helena
message: 「Hey now. We aren't talking about me right now, are we?」

name: Synn
message: 「I-I apologize again and again...」

name: Helena
message: 「Whether it's in the Student Council or the Crusaders, you've been breaking down old conventions and pushing forward with positive reforms, Synn-chan」

name: Helena
message: 「That's a very important quality. Don't let yourself get bogged down by pointless formalities and let it wither away... okay?」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-Yes. Understood」

name: Helena
message: 「Really?」

name: Synn
message: 「To be honest, I don't quite get it, but I memorized everything you just said, Helena-san. That way, I can recall it as many times as I need」

name: Helena
message: 「Then that's good enough!!」

name: Ria
message: 「Aah!? I figured it out, Sis!」

name: Ria
message: 「You used a straw to suck out only the sweet bean paste! No doubt about it, that's the right answer, hmph!」

name: Helena
message: 「Bzzzt, wrong」

name: Ria
message: 「Urgh... I missed again」

name: Synn
message: 「R-Ria-senpai?」

name: Ria
message: 「Eh, eeeh...?」

name: Ria
message: 「Kyaaaah! Synn, how long have you been standing there!?」

name: Paqy
message: 「What on earth happened to Ria?」

name: Helena
message: 「Foh-foh-foh-foh, I simply gave my stiff-headed little sister a riddle」

name: Helena
message: 「How can one eat only the red bean paste inside a kashiwamochi without breaking the outer skin?」

name: Ria
message: 「Hmm-hmm, mmm-mmm...」

name: Synn
message: 「Extract the red bean paste using a matter transporter」

name: Helena
message: 「Close!」

name: Synn
message: 「T―That answer was close? No way, don't tell me―」

name: Synn
message: 「First, cover the eater's entire body in red bean paste, then coat them in mochi. That way, you don't have to break the skin」

name: Ria
message: 「S―Synn... that's absurd―」

name: Helena
message: 「Ding-ding-ding-ding! Synn-chan, spot on~♪」

name: Ria
message: 「Eeeeh!?」

name: Synn
message: 「I-I actually got it right. What am I supposed to do now?」

name: Paqy
message: 「For starters, just celebrate」

name: Helena
message: 「Indeed. For someone as quick-witted as you, here is your prize!!」

name: Ria
message: 「Big Sis, that's unfair! If you actually did that, the person inside the red bean paste would suffocate!」

name: Ria
message: 「Sure, you didn't put a size limit on the kashiwamochi, but that's total cheating!」

name: Ria
message: 「Ah... though if you poked air holes in advance--」

name: Ria
message: 「N-No, don't fall for it! There's no way one person could eat that much red bean paste anyway. Hmph!」

name: Helena
message: 「Oh my? Refusing to accept it even after hearing the right answer... honestly, Ria, what a stiff little girl you are」

name: Helena
message: 「Ufufu\s04 Big Sis will give you a good kneading to soften you right up」

name: Ria
message: 「W-What part of me are you talking about?」

name: Helena
message: 「O-f c-o-u-r-s-e...♪」

name: Ria
message: 「S-Synn...!」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, yes. I'll head out so I don't get in the way」

name: Synn
message: 「Before that, Helena-san. If you don't mind, please share your thoughts on the preparations for KiraFes」

name: Helena
message: 「Beyond words!」

name: Helena
message: 「Ufufufu」

name: Synn
message: 「E-excuse me」

name: Helena
message: 「Yes, yes, come again~」

name: Ria
message: 「S-Synn-kun...... wait! That's not it, help--」

name: Helena
message: 「Synn-chan sure knows how to read the room! Take thaaat~♪ Tickle, tickle, tickle~~」

name: Ria
message: 「Ah, haun! N-nooo, kuuun」
